description: This file defines a Flutter widget for the 'Budgets' screen in a budgeting app. It manages the UI for displaying a list of budgets, handles data loading via a provider, and integrates with a transaction repository to show spending progress within each budget.

classes.name: BudgetsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a list of budgets and manages loading state.

classes.name: _BudgetsScreenState
classes.description: State class for BudgetsScreen, manages data loading and widget building.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Loads budgets data when dependencies change and data has not been loaded yet.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the budgets list, handling loading states, empty states, and rendering each budget with progress indicators.
